decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The marquee hereby approved shall be removed permanently on, or before, 1st November 2009.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - Reason for approval

The proposed temporary marquee, by means of its positioning, size, scale, design and appearance, would not harm the appearance of the site or the surrounding locality, nor would it result in any adverse traffic or pedestrian safety related impacts.  Its use would complement the primary function of the supermarket and it is therefore considered to be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, Adopted December 2003.
description: Change of use of the car park for the erection of a marquee for the display and retailing of Horticultural Products
